item.title: Mu and Queijos Scala launch Protein Parmesan Snack in Brazil
item.description: Mu in Brazil launches a unique Protein Parmesan Snack with Queijos Scala, diverging from its traditional wafer-style protein bars.

item.title: Be Legend Protein now in Thailand at Muscle Incorporate
item.description: Japanese sports nutrition brand Be Legend expands internationally for the first time, introducing its popular protein powder to Thailand.

item.title: Experience the revamped WrathX Energy Drink by MuscleBlaze
item.description: MuscleBlaze has revitalized its WrathX Energy Drink with a new look, improved formula, and enhanced flavors by 2026.

item.title: Surreal's newly released Peanut Butter High Protein Granola
item.description: Surreal expands its high protein granola range with a new Peanut Butter flavor, emphasizing low sugar and high protein content.

item.title: USN Immune Hydrator Drink boosts hydration with immune support
item.description: USN UK's Immune Hydrator is a hybrid beverage combining hydration and immune support, featuring electrolytes, vitamins, and natural sweeteners.

item.title: Punchies Protein Gummies delicious high-protein treats for kids
item.description: Punchies has innovated the gummy candy market by creating kid-friendly protein gummies made with real fruit and premium whey isolate.

item.title: Perfect Snacks Protein+ Prebiotics Bar offers protein and gut health
item.description: Perfect Snacks has launched the Protein+ Prebiotics Bar, combining muscle-building protein with gut health-enhancing prebiotics.

item.title: Myprotein's authentic collaboration Mars Bar Impact Whey Protein
item.description: Myprotein has launched a Mars Bar-flavored Impact Whey Protein, offering authentic candy taste with healthy nutritional benefits.

item.title: Discover Bingeworthy Snacks' incredibly lean Protein Beef Crisps
item.description: Bingeworthy Snacks' signature Beef Crisps offer a lean, protein-rich snack option with minimal calories and no carbohydrates.

item.title: Gatorade Thirst Quencher upcoming All-American Mashups
item.description: Gatorade is launching a limited edition All-American Mashups flavor with a patriotic design, likely timed for the 4th of July.

item.title: EHP and Jaden Laing's Jaden Island Punch OxyShred Energy
item.description: EHP Labs and influencer Jaden Laing launch Jaden's Island Punch OxyShred Energy Drink with a tropical flavor, enhanced focus ingredients, and a larger 500ml can.

item.title: Applied Nutrition's ABE Golden Tub at the 2026 Arnold Expo UK
item.description: Applied Nutrition will showcase its products and offer chances to win £1000 vouchers at the Arnold Sports Festival in Birmingham.

item.title: Body Attack Germany introduces delicious flavored creatine drink
item.description: Body Attack in Germany has introduced flavored versions of its 100% Pure Creatine Monohydrate, offering Lemon Lime and Watermelon options.

item.title: Mammut Nutrition's decadent Triple Chocolate Protein Cookie
item.description: Mammut Nutrition has launched a decadent Triple Chocolate Protein Cookie, emphasizing taste over macros, with 20g protein and 347 calories.

item.title: Wolf Supplements' Wolf Hydrate for optimal hydration benefits
item.description: Wolf Supplements' new Wolf Hydrate offers a high-electrolyte formula with added creatine for improved hydration and endurance at a competitive price.
